_: Copy to new_project.local.json (git-ignored) for tools/new_project.py. No secret goes here: the token is in header_file.
_platform: gitea. github and gitlab are refused, changing nothing, until the tool has their code: docs/project-practices.md
_header_file: A file holding one line, 'Authorization: token <token>', of an account that may create repositories in owner. Relative to this file, or absolute; ~ is the user's folder.
_actions: false when the server has no runner: the new repository's Actions are turned off, so nothing waits in a queue.
_protection: How the main branch is protected; these are the defaults.
_ca_file: Optional: the organization's own certificate authority, when the server's certificate is issued by it.
